It does not involve a differential perturbation or treatment comparison (e.g., drug vs vehicle, WT vs KO) as the primary axis of the proteomics experiment; rather, it compares different purified subcomplexes to determine their composition and connectivity. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
